announcements.headline: Bibemi Gold Project Update
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources provides a project update following the recent confirmation of high-grade limestone and a substantial maiden resource estimate at Wapouzé.

announcements.headline: Substantial Maiden Resource Estimate at Wapouzé
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources confirms high-grade limestone at Wapouzé, building on its central licence package update. This substantial resource estimate advances the project following earlier exploration milestones.

announcements.headline: High-grade Limestone Confirmed at Wapouzé Project
announcements.insight: High-grade limestone confirmation follows the July drilling completion. This validates the project's potential but lacks commercial scale details for immediate shareholder valuation.

announcements.headline: Sale of Muratdere Royalty
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources disposes of the Muratdere royalty, following recent drilling completion and licence updates. This divestment may provide capital for ongoing exploration activities.

announcements.headline: Central Licence Package Update
announcements.insight: Following the July completion of drilling and joint venture activities, this update likely relates to licence administration. Shareholders should monitor for further operational milestones.

announcements.headline: Zeus Capital Research Report
announcements.insight: Zeus Capital issued a research report. This follows recent governance updates including director appointments in July.

announcements.headline: Non-Executive Director and Corporate Appointments
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources appoints a Non-Executive Director following its recent restructuring and joint venture completion. This board change supports governance as operations progress.

announcements.headline: Completion of Maiden Drilling at Wapouzé
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources confirms completion of maiden drilling at Wapouzé. This follows earlier updates on Eastern CLP and Mbe ownership, indicating continued exploration activity.

announcements.headline: Completion of Senala Joint Venture Agreement
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources completes a joint venture agreement following its June restructuring. Shareholders should monitor how this partnership impacts the Mbe asset.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow the May exploration update and June restructuring confirming 50% ownership of Mbe.

announcements.headline: Restructuring confirms 50% ownership of Mbe
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources confirms 50% ownership of Mbe following its May exploration update. This restructuring establishes a joint venture structure for the asset.

announcements.headline: Eastern CLP Gold Exploration Update
announcements.insight: Oriole Resources provides an update on its Eastern CLP Gold Exploration. Shareholders should monitor for further technical results or development milestones.
